title: どこにも + Verb + ないです
romaji: doko ni mo + Verb + nai desu
shortExplanation: Express that an action cannot be performed anywhere or something cannot be found anywhere.
longExplanation: The grammar point どこにも + Verb + ないです is used to express that an action cannot be performed anywhere or something cannot be found anywhere. It is used with a negative verb conjugation (ない-form) and highlights the unavailability or impossibility of finding or doing something in any location.
formation: どこにも + Verb in ない-form + です

examples.jp: どこにも傘が売ってないです。
examples.romaji: Doko ni mo kasa ga uttenai desu.

examples.jp: 彼はどこにも見つけられないです。
examples.romaji: Kare wa doko ni mo mitsukerarenai desu.

examples.jp: どこにも勉強できる場所がないです。
examples.romaji: Doko ni mo benkyou dekiru basho ga nai desu.
examples.en: There is no place to study anywhere.

examples.jp: どこにも美味しいビーガン料理がないです。
examples.romaji: Doko ni mo oishii bi-gan ryouri ga nai desu.
examples.en: There are no delicious vegan dishes anywhere.

usageNote: Standard polite negative - "not anywhere". (どこへも variant of n5-105's どこにも.)
